script:
N2=$(control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/count --field .)
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --json "{\"workspace\": {\"working_dir\": \"$W\"}}" \
  --expect 422 --check detail.0.msg contains 'must be provided' --save F04.create-validation/no-agent-source
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --json "{\"workspace\": {\"working_dir\": \"$W\"}, \"agent_profile_id\": \"$PID\", \"agent_settings\": {}}" \
  --expect 422 --check detail.0.msg contains 'mutually exclusive'
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --json "{\"agent\": $OFFLINE_AGENT}" --expect 422 --check detail.0.loc contains workspace
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --json "{\"workspace\": {\"working_dir\": \"$W\"}, \"agent\": $OFFLINE_AGENT, \"tags\": {\"Bad-Key\": \"x\"}}" \
  --expect 422 --check detail.0.msg contains 'lowercase alphanumeric'
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --json "{\"workspace\": {\"working_dir\": \"$W\"}, \"agent\": $OFFLINE_AGENT, \"max_iterations\": 0}" --expect 422
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --json "{\"workspace\": {\"working_dir\": \"$W\"}, \"agent_settings\": {\"agent_kind\": \"nope\"}}" --expect 422
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --json "{\"workspace\": {\"working_dir\": \"$W\"}, \"agent_profile_id\": \"$NOPE\"}" \
  --expect 404 --check detail contains 'not found'
control-agent-server api POST /api/agent-profiles/qa-f04-dangling --json '{"llm_profile_ref": "qa-f04-missing", "tools": []}' --expect 201
DANGLING=$(control-agent-server api GET /api/agent-profiles/qa-f04-dangling --field profile.id)
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --json "{\"workspace\": {\"working_dir\": \"$W\"}, \"agent_profile_id\": \"$DANGLING\"}" \
  --expect 422 --check detail.code eq unresolved_profile_references \
  --check detail.dangling_llm_profile_ref eq qa-f04-missing --save F04.create-validation/dangling-profile
control-agent-server api DELETE /api/agent-profiles/qa-f04-dangling --expect 200
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie> --json "{\"workspace\": {\"working_dir\": \"$W\"}, \"agent\": $OFFLINE_AGENT}" --auth none --expect 401
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/count --check . eq "$N2"
